name: neststudio-usermods
description: User-mod loader, installer and bundled mods for Nest Studio (Nestworks desktop CNC software)

scripts.watch: concurrently -n loader,mods -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter @neststudio-usermods/loader run watch" "pnpm --filter \"./mods/**\" --parallel run watch"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node packages/loader/dist/tests/harness.js && pnpm --filter @neststudio-mods/pcb-import test
